notes.itemTitle: Pay the Campus France EEF fee
notes.title: Campus France wants proof
notes.text: Campus France asked this morning for your transfer proof plus the bank and account holder's name. You sent the bank and the payment method, but not the holder's name. - Send that one line now, since each round with them takes two to three working days.

notes.title: Book VFS before you fly
notes.text: Your file is validated and the EEF fee is paid, so the VFS appointment is yours to book. It is dated 10 November, three days after you leave Jakarta on 7 November. - Take the earliest slot before you fly, and tell me the date so I can move this.
